name: Jixin Hou
tagline: Understanding how the brain takes shape.
subtitle: Computational Brain Biomechanics · Neuroimaging · AI
intro: I combine developmental neuroimaging, computational mechanics, and interpretable AI to uncover the physical principles of human brain growth, folding, and development.

research.title: Developmental cortical mapping

research.text: Building anatomically realistic finite-element models of cortical growth and folding.

research.title: Interpretable scientific AI
research.text: Using machine learning and symbolic regression to discover compact, physics-compatible models.
